newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RBA says watching rising Australian house prices.
newsitem.headline: RBA says watching rising Australian house prices.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) said on Tuesday it would now be watching strong rises in house prices in some parts of Melbourne and Sydney for signs of higher inflationary expectations.
The RBA said in its August bulletin that the price rises had been localised so far and did not seem to indicate higher expectations.

"At this stage the rises in house prices have been reasonably localised and do not seem to indicate any general increase in inflationary expectations, although this will be an area to be watched as the housing upturn continues," the RBA
In its May Monetary Policy statement, the bank did not say it was watching prices and commented that excess housing stock could restrain the pace of recovery in the housing sector.
